$comment: The file formats SynapseRead opens, in the order the app names them. `extensions` is exactly `DocumentFormat::EXTENSIONS` in this order (the native picker filter), and `format` is what each extension registers as. The drop overlay and empty-state copy are built from `label`, so all three name the same formats. Markdown registers as `txt` until the Markdown reader exists: see docs/adr/0007-markdown-as-text.md.
